potd.title: Beneath the Heartbeat
potd.description: Framed from directly beneath the glide path, this Southwest Airlines Boeing 737NG highlights the iconic flattened CFM56 engine nacelles and exposed main gear bays on short final. Wrapped in the striking Heart livery, the twinjet offers a powerful, perfectly symmetrical perspective just seconds before touchdown.

potd.title: Golden Superjumbo
potd.description: This Qantas Airbus A380 superjumbo lines up on short final with its gear down and massive turbofans catching the warm sunlight. Named David Warren in honor of the Australian scientist who invented the flight data recorder, the iconic double-decker aircraft epitomizes the grand scale of long-haul international aviation.

potd.title: Threshold Geometry
potd.description: Framed directly against a field of altocumulus clouds, this Boeing 757 passes over an approach lighting tower while configured gear-down for landing. The planform view highlights the airliner's high-aspect-ratio wing sweep, tall efficiency-boosting blended winglets, and pristine belly symmetry.

potd.title: Scimitar Silhouette
potd.description: Captured from directly below, this Delta Boeing 737-900ER displays its striking blue belly logo and distinctive Split Scimitar winglets against a dappled cloud canopy. The vertical perspective showcases the airliner's extended fuselage geometry, deployable main gear, and flap track fairings as it descends on final approach.

potd.title: Queen
potd.description: Rendered in high-contrast black and white, this AirBridgeCargo Boeing 747-8F presents a formidable front profile as it taxies along the tarmac. The distinctive chevron engine nacelles and sweeping raked wingtips highlight the modern aerodynamic refinements of Boeing's ultimate "Queen of the Skies" freighter.
